verses.text: Dear friends, do not believe every spirit. Test the spirits to see whether they come from God, because many false prophets have gone out into the world.
This is how you can know the Spirit of God: every spirit that says Jesus Christ came as a real human being is from God.
But every spirit that does not say this about Jesus is not from God. That is the spirit of the Antichrist. You heard that it was coming, and now it is already in the world.
Little children, you belong to God, and you have won against them, because the one who is in you is greater than the one who is in the world.
They belong to the world. So they speak the way the world speaks, and the world listens to them.
We belong to God. Anyone who knows God listens to us. Anyone who is not from God does not listen to us. This is how we can tell the spirit of truth from the spirit of lies.
Dear friends, let us love one another, because love comes from God. Everyone who loves has been born of God and knows God.
Anyone who does not love does not know God, because God is love.
This is how God showed his love among us: he sent his only Son into the world so that we could have life through him.
This is what love is: not that we loved God, but that he loved us and sent his Son as the sacrifice that takes away our sins.
Dear friends, since God loved us this much, we should also love one another.
No one has ever seen God. But if we love one another, God lives in us, and his love is made complete in us.
This is how we know that we live in him and he lives in us: he has given us his Spirit.
We have seen, and we tell others, that the Father sent his Son to be the Saviour of the world.
If anyone says that Jesus is the Son of God, God lives in him, and he lives in God.
We know the love God has for us, and we believe it. God is love. Anyone who lives in love lives in God, and God lives in him.
This is how love is made complete among us, so that we can be bold on the day God judges. For in this world we are like Jesus.
There is no fear in love. Perfect love drives out fear, because fear has to do with punishment. Anyone who is afraid has not been made perfect in love.
We love him, because he loved us first.
If anyone says, "I love God," but hates his brother, he is a liar. If he does not love his brother, whom he has seen, he cannot love God, whom he has not seen.
And he has given us this command: anyone who loves God must also love his brother.
